facts.fact: Togo First reports that the commune of Golfe 3 launched online declaration of births and deaths on 28 March 2024, under which the municipality's civil-status agents are connected to health centres in the commune through the Hospi-connect and Hospi-gestion platforms and receive declarations in real time; the article does not say how the town hall itself is connected.
facts.system: Golfe 3 civil-status service online link to health centres (Hospi-connect, Hospi-gestion)

facts.fact: Togo First reports that the online birth and death declaration linking municipal civil-status agents to health centres was at its pilot phase in one commune, Golfe 3, with two public health facilities (CMS Doumassessé and CHU Campus) in the trial.
facts.system: Golfe 3 civil-status service online link to health centres (Hospi-connect, Hospi-gestion)
